record.reason: Read the primary ReAttn method, ranking experiments, and limitations. It is an attention-based LLM reranker intended as an efficient alternative to generation-based reranking and introduces post-hoc cross-document IDF and entropy weighting; however, its contribution is retrieval ranking quality, not optimization of model inference execution/serving, so scope fit is weak.
record.title: ReAttn: Improving Attention-based Re-ranking via Attention Re-weighting
